name: Flatiron bites & brews
description: Flatiron Bites & Brews offers a vibrant karaoke experience within a welcoming restaurant environment. Guests can enjoy a lively atmosphere with a good selection of drinks and food, including local beers and house-made dishes. The venue features a sound system suitable for karaoke, and reviews highlight friendly staff and a fun, inclusive vibe. It’s a popular spot for both casual singing nights and private events, making it a standout destination for karaoke lovers seeking good food and a great time.
